scripts.postinstall: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; try { const s=path.resolve('node_modules'), d=path.resolve('..','node_modules'); if(fs.existsSync(s)&&!fs.existsSync(d)) fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true}); } catch(e) { console.warn('postinstall:', e.message); }"
